method: Every final assigned page was individually viewed again at its original PNG resolution through view_image(detail=original), in two batches of six pages. No page-review transfer was assumed and no contact sheet was used as sole evidence.
observations: Opening fits one substantial page in the original type size, with the claim boundary and all source/history qualifications intact.
Two contents pages are balanced with intact chapter blocks and readable section/page mappings.
Chapter 2 title fits on one line without a split word.
All diagrams, captions, mathematical displays and body text are readable and unclipped. No overlapping content or isolated one-word tails in assigned pages.
The shorter chapter 1 final page contains a substantial concluding paragraph and claim box, which is a conventional chapter ending.
